title: Release train contingency and communications plan for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a concise contingency and communications plan that translates technical release signals (latency/SLO regressions, autoscale failures, model quality regressions) into clear cut criteria, escalation paths, and templated customer/internal messaging for the API, Console, and Runtime components. Goal: reduce decision latency during T-0 to T+72h and ensure consistent cross-team actions and public comms across hosting modes.
acceptance_criteria: A single one-page contingency rubric exists that maps technical signals to recommended action (hold / hotfix / rollback / limited rollout)
Per-component rollback thresholds defined and agreed (API, Console, Runtime) with eng leads and SRE
Ready-to-send internal and external message templates for top 5 failure scenarios in Drive
A rehearsal runbook executed once with PM, Eng, SRE, Design, Legal, and Support and a retro recorded
Owners and on-call names listed with phone/Slack escalation steps
timeline_milestones: 2026-02-16: Initial draft and tech-signal mapping completed
2026-02-24: Message templates drafted and reviewed by Legal
2026-03-10: Publish plan to Confluence and share in release kickoff
2026-03-15: Lock plan and mark as release artifact
cut_criteria: API: 99.95% success rate for 3 rolling minutes on production traffic simulator OR revert to previous API shard within 30 minutes
Console: >3 user-visible errors per minute for >10 minutes in staging during rollout -> pause rollout and escalate
Runtime: token-latency P95 increase >30% over baseline AND error rate >0.5% -> trigger canary rollback
Model Quality: automated eval drop >3% on core prompt suite -> block general rollout, enable limited beta with opt-in customers
Capacity: sustained queue depth >2x expected for 15 minutes -> scale back non-critical traffic and notify customers
communication_channels: Internal: #release-ops Slack, PagerDuty rotation, weekly release bridge Zoom
External: Status Page (status.redwood.ai), Customer Success email templates, Partner channel messages
Docs: Confluence plan (link below), Drive folder with assets, GitHub PRs for rollback scripts
contingency_strategies: Immediate mitigation: route traffic to last-known-good model variant and reduce burst capacity for new sessions
Hotfix path: prioritized PRs with pre-approved CI gates and 30-minute deployment window
Rollback path: automated rollback playbook to previous runtime binary per-region with a 2-step confirmation
Partial rollout: restrict feature flags to 10% of traffic and expand in 25% increments only after 30m stable windows
Customer escalation: CS runbook to provide status, expected ETA, and compensation offer templates
open_risks: Cross-region rollback complexity: data-plane changes may not be symmetric across regions
Model variant parity: fallback model may produce degraded user experience requiring clear messaging
Console dependency graph: Console outages can obscure API health signals (need heartbeat monitoring)
Legal approval lag for external messaging during late-night incidents
Limited SRE bandwidth during adjacent platform incidents (on-call conflicts)
